mood: Technical, precise, dense, command-center. Built for a backend developer who values speed, data density, and keyboard navigation.

headings.usage: Used for all dashboard widgets, metrics, project titles, and Kanban column headers.

body.usage: Used for task descriptions, markdown notes, and dense text to maintain readability.

layout_strategy.grid_system: The 'Control Room' Grid. High density, tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use strict grid allocations for dashboard.
layout_strategy.borders: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Use 1px subtle borders (border-border/40). Remove border-radius on cards or use max 2px.
layout_strategy.spacing: Dense spacing for data tables and task lists (p-2 to p-4). Generous spacing only for empty states or auth screens.
layout_strategy.alignment: Left-align all data, stats, and text. Center alignment is banned except for empty state illustrations.

component_rules.cards: Cardless or flat surfaces with 1px border. No drop shadows. Use a 1px solid border (border-[#262626]). Background should be #141414.
component_rules.buttons: Square edges (rounded-none). High contrast. Primary button: bg-[#F59E0B] text-black hover:bg-[#D97706].
component_rules.kanban: Columns should have visible right borders. Task cards should be draggable, dense, displaying tags and due dates with JetBrains Mono. Use subtle hover state: slightly lighter surface.
component_rules.forms: Inputs should have sharp corners, transparent backgrounds with bottom-border only, or full 1px border. Focus state must be a sharp 1px ring of primary_accent.
component_rules.markdown: Render markdown with tight line height. Use JetBrains Mono for inline code blocks with a slightly lighter grey background (#262626).
component_rules.navigation: Left-side vertical sidebar (Command Center nav) or dense top nav. Active state marked by a left-border primary_accent highlight.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Fast and snappy. No long fades. Changes in background color should be 0.1s. Buttons get a hard translation (e.g., translate-x-0.5 translate-y-0.5) to simulate mechanical pressing.
motion_and_interaction.micro_interactions: Use 'Tracing Beam' effect on the active project card or currently tracking task. Use a subtle pulse on the 'Time Tracking' active state.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: None or instant. Developers prefer speed over animations.

image_urls.description: Abstract composition showcasing modern architectural elements with dramatic lighting. Use as a darkened, low-opacity background for the login/register screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not introduce generic blue or purple.
Install and configure 'JetBrains Mono' and 'IBM Plex Sans' fonts via Google Fonts in index.html or layout.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to remove all border-radius (use rounded-none or rounded-sm max) and drop-shadows. The UI should look flat, technical, and brutalist.
Ensure all task rows and Kanban cards have 'data-testid' attributes for testing.
For the Kanban board, implement drag-and-drop using standard React DnD or similar, maintaining the dense, grid-based aesthetic.
For the Dashboard, use Recharts with the primary_accent (#F59E0B) for lines/bars and #262626 for grid lines. Keep charts minimalist and data-heavy.
Do not use card components where a simple grid border layout works better. Emphasize the 'Terminal' Micro-Theme with monospace stats.
Generate all frontend components as .jsx/.js files instead of .tsx/.ts.
